item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, the weather will remain unsettled over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. There will be showers and squally thunderstorms, showers will be heavy at times. With the subtropical ridge extending westwards, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas east of Taiwan today.

Date/Month: 18/08 (Sunday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy in some areas in the morning.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
